count_bug_correction.corrected_behavior: nonmanifold_face_count is the count of faces that actually have one or more incident positional edges with more than two face uses
count_bug_correction.previous_error: nonmanifold_face_count counted every face visited during component reporting because a defaultdict lookup inserted empty entries for manifold faces

data_use_scope: Use only each logical object winding_report.non_manifold_edge_count and corrected non_manifold_face_count to replace the erroneous winding diagnostic field in the compact metrics. This report does not revise any geometry acceptance status or gate.

geometry_policy.mutation: read_only; no vertex weld, face, winding, or normal edits
geometry_policy.provider_boundary_gate: measured at every requested tolerance; pass only when every count is below 200
geometry_policy.report_status_scope: Raw read-only inspector status only; it is not a revised package acceptance result. Compact metrics acceptance remains 34 blocked / 4 pass and parent updates only exact-position winding non-manifold face counts.
geometry_policy.stream_grouping: combine all material streams under one named logical PDX object with index offsets before topology or winding analysis; keep source stream capacities separately

purpose: Corrected geometry-only measurements for the 38 current installed model registrations, generated with the locked pure io_pdx_mesh parser and logical-object stream grouping.
